analysis.evidence: The plural verb agrees with יְמֵי in כָּל יְמֵי אֱנוֹשׁ, “all the days of Enosh.” The phrase חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה gives the total of his lifespan, 905 years.
analysis.morphology: Qal wayyiqtol, third-person masculine plural, with prefixed conjunction וַ־.
analysis.sense: to amount to a stated total

analysis.evidence: In כָּל יְמֵי אֱנוֹשׁ, “all the days of Enosh,” כָּל takes his days together as one lifespan. The verse gives their total as 905 years.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular construct noun, without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: כָּל יְמֵי אֱנוֹשׁ means “all the days of Enosh.” The verse gives their total as 905 years and closes with וַיָּמֹת, “and he died,” identifying the days as his entire lifespan.
analysis.sense: (pl.) days of a life, a reign or an age

analysis.evidence: In כָּל יְמֵי אֱנוֹשׁ, “all the days of Enosh,” the name identifies the man whose lifespan is totaled as 905 years. The verse closes with וַיָּמֹת, “and he died.”
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular proper noun without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים means “five years.” The following וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה adds nine hundred years, giving Enosh a lifespan of 905 years.

In חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים, “five years,” שָׁנִים supplies the unit counted by חָמֵשׁ. These five years and the following nine hundred years make up כָּל יְמֵי אֱנוֹשׁ, “all the days of Enosh,” giving his lifespan as 905 years.
analysis.morphology: Common noun, feminine plural absolute, without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: In וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה, תְשַׁע counts nine hundreds, giving “and nine hundred years.” With the preceding חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים, Enosh’s lifespan totals 905 years.
analysis.morphology: Cardinal numeral, plural absolute, without prefix or suffix.
analysis.sense: hundreds (plural מֵאוֹת, with the digits: three hundred to nine hundred)

analysis.evidence: In וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה, the singular שָׁנָה supplies the unit for ‘nine hundred years’. The preceding חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים adds five years, giving 905 years as the total of כָּל יְמֵי אֱנוֹשׁ, ‘all the days of Enosh’, before his death.
analysis.morphology: Common noun, feminine singular absolute, without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: After giving Enosh’s lifespan as 905 years, the verse closes with וַיָּמֹת. The masculine singular subject is Enosh, and the verb reports his death.
analysis.morphology: Qal wayyiqtol, third person masculine singular, with prefixed וַ
analysis.sense: die, come to the end of life
